how_to_use: REELS ONLY (since 12 Nov 2026): each day needs 3 reels (09:00, 13:00, 19:30). Take topics in this order: first the 'reel' list, then 'post', 'carousel_concept', 'carousel_interview' lists (all are reel topics now). Unused = not in state.json history. The 3 reels of a day must cover 3 different areas and 3 different formats. When lists run out, invent new topics in the same spirit, rotating areas: basics, DDIC, internal tables, SQL/performance, ALV, selection screens, OO ABAP, module pool, SmartForms/Adobe Forms, enhancements/BAdIs, BAPI/BDC/IDoc, debugging, S/4HANA/CDS/RAP, interview scenarios. Never repeat a topic in history. 13:00 reel: even day-of-month plugs ABAP Code Vault in the caption, odd day-of-month uses an interview angle and plugs ABAP Interview Pack.
